styleLock.direction: fresh macaron pastel personal-care appliance commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: cloud blue #C7DCEA seamless studio backdrops with soft radial gradients, pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and variant screens, sakura pink #F2A9B8 for close and warm accent screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft cool diffused studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, smooth gradient falloff, soft contact shadows only, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio backdrop and soft matte pedestal blocks, no reflective flooring
styleLock.typography: modern rounded geometric sans-serif headlines in deep ocean blue #3E6E9E or charcoal grey, all copy wrapped in 「」, short labels 10-14pt and headlines 28-48pt
styleLock.iconSystem: simple flat thin-line icons in deep ocean blue #3E6E9E, low complexity
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set, product always cleanly separated from props, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh macaron pastel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud blue #C7DCEA, sakura pink #F2A9B8, pure white #FFFFFF and one deep ocean blue accent #3E6E9E; soft cool diffused studio lighting with a front-left key, smooth gradient falloff and soft contact shadows; modern rounded geometric sans-serif headlines with all copy wrapped in 「」; consistent rounded rectangle info cards; consistent simple flat thin-line icon style in #3E6E9E; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 10 张小圆电吹风爆款详情切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字、原文案、模特、二维码与会员水印贴片；panel-03 羽毛装饰页并入轻量卖点镜，panel-04 近似空白版式页丢弃；负离子浓度、风力、重量等不可验证数据一律改为 {selling_point}/{callout} 占位交由使用方填写；信任镜以风嘴接缝与哑光机身微距等可验证材质细节呈现。
